groups.name: Enemies with ranged attacks
groups.definition: Enemies that can attack from a distance using fired or thrown projectiles.

groups.name: Ancient Evil God Hands
groups.definition: The four God Hand Wonder Weapons in Ancient Evil.

groups.name: GobbleGum names about money
groups.definition: GobbleGum names containing a financial term or payment method.

groups.name: Aether Specialist Weapons
groups.definition: The four Specialist Weapons selectable in Black Ops 4's Aether maps.

groups.name: Black Ops 3 Whimsical GobbleGums
groups.definition: The four cosmetic Whimsical GobbleGums in Black Ops 3.

groups.name: Classic starting handguns
groups.definition: Default starting handguns from World at War through Black Ops 4, excluding optional loadout choices and quest rewards.

groups.name: Perks introduced in Black Ops 1
groups.definition: Perk-a-Colas that first appeared in Black Ops 1.

groups.name: Perk names containing drinks
groups.definition: Perk names containing the name of a drink, such as cola, wine, or macchiato.

groups.name: D.I.E. elemental upgrades
groups.definition: The four elemental modifications of the D.I.E. Shockwave in Die Maschine.

groups.name: Snowy maps
groups.definition: Maps with snow-covered outdoor areas. Changing weather, as in Origins, also counts.

groups.name: Enemies with explosive deaths
groups.definition: Enemies that can release a harmful explosion or gas burst when killed.

groups.name: Enemy types introduced in Black Ops 7
groups.definition: Distinct special, elite, or named enemy types that first appeared in Black Ops 7.

groups.name: Maps with teleporters
groups.definition: Maps with fixed, usable teleporters or travel portals. Cutscene-only travel and consumable teleportation are excluded.

groups.name: Effects that hide you from zombies
groups.definition: Abilities or power-ups that temporarily make zombies ignore you.

groups.name: Perk-granting GobbleGums
groups.definition: GobbleGums that award perks directly, through a power-up, or alongside a perk purchase.

groups.name: GobbleGums introduced in Black Ops 7
groups.definition: GobbleGum names that first appeared in Black Ops 7, including post-launch additions.

groups.name: Effects triggered by reloading
groups.definition: Perks or GobbleGums that damage nearby enemies when you reload. Elemental Pop uses its upgraded or augmented effect.

groups.name: Primis
groups.definition: The younger, alternate-universe versions of Dempsey, Nikolai, Takeo, and Richtofen.

groups.name: Maps with soul-fed creature heads
groups.definition: Maps where feeding zombies to fixed dog or dragon heads unlocks equipment.

groups.name: Maps with ziplines or ascenders
groups.definition: Maps with usable ziplines or powered ascenders. Gondolas and enclosed cable cars are excluded.

groups.name: Black Ops 4 perk gods
groups.definition: The four gods represented by perk statues in Black Ops 4's Chaos maps.

groups.name: Maps introduced in Black Ops 4
groups.definition: Maps first released under these names in Black Ops 4, including DLC.

groups.name: Ways to revive your own body
groups.definition: Mechanics that let you control a separate form to revive your downed body. Tombstone Soda uses its Cold War effect.

groups.name: Liberty Falls Jet Gun parts
groups.definition: The three components used to build the Jet Gun in Liberty Falls.

groups.name: Playable female characters
groups.definition: Named female characters playable in Treyarch Zombies, including playable Operators.

groups.name: Wonder Weapons introduced in Black Ops 7

groups.name: The Chaos crew

groups.name: Ultimis
groups.definition: The original versions of Dempsey, Nikolai, Takeo, and Richtofen.

groups.name: Requiem's senior staff

groups.name: Cold War Field Upgrades

groups.name: Mob of the Dead prisoners

groups.definition: GobbleGums explicitly classified Ultra-Rare Mega in BO3.

groups.name: Maps set on islands

groups.definition: Maps where players can ride a lift or elevator between levels, including quest-only lifts.

groups.name: Effects that turn zombies into allies
